title: Dassault Systèmes agrees to acquire ArisGlobal, a US supplier of software to the life sciences industry, from Nordic Capital for ~$2B, set to close in H2 2026 (Adrià Calatayud/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Adrià Calatayud / Wall Street Journal: Dassault Systèmes agrees to acquire ArisGlobal, a US supplier of software to the life sciences industry, from Nordic Capital for ~$2B, set to close in H2 2026 — Completion is expected in the second half, subject to approvals — Dassault Systemes said it agreed to buy Nordic Capital's ArisGlobal …
contentText:
Adrià Calatayud / Wall Street Journal :

Dassault Systèmes agrees to acquire ArisGlobal, a US supplier of software to the life sciences industry, from Nordic Capital for ~$2B, set to close in H2 2026   —  Completion is expected in the second half, subject to approvals  —  Dassault Systemes said it agreed to buy Nordic Capital's ArisGlobal …
